Grammatical Data Preparation for Central Network Coupled with Environmental Heatmaps

Source: R/grammar_env_network.R
cli_env_network_data.Rd

Generates the complete spatial layout, node coordinates, intra-module edge segments, convex hulls, peripheral triangular heatmap coordinates, and curved inter-domain link trajectories. The returned cli_env_network_data S3 object serves as the data foundation for the modular grammar layers (geom_env_boundary, geom_env_central_network, geom_env_corner_heatmaps, and geom_env_links).

Usage

cli_env_network_data(
  comm_data = NULL,
  env_data = NULL,
  nodes = NULL,
  edges = NULL,
  env_cors = NULL,
  links = NULL,
  modules = NULL,
  module_labels = NULL,
  module_colors = NULL,
  corner_palettes = NULL,
  link_colors = c(Positive = "#E64B35", Negative = "#4DBBD5"),
  label_type = c("auto", "stars", "coef", "coef_stars", "none"),
  show_asterisks = TRUE,
  show_values = FALSE,
  value_digits = 2,
  value_size = NULL,
  compact = TRUE,
  show_module_labels = TRUE,
  module_label_size = 2.4,
  module_label_color = "grey15",
  module_label_fill = "white",
  module_label_bg = TRUE,
  module_label_alpha = 1,
  module_label_pos = c("radial", "centroid"),
  show_module_legend = TRUE,
  legend_position = "top",
  show_domain_labels = TRUE,
  env_label_size = 1.95,
  env_label_color = "grey20",
  env_label_face = "plain",
  link_width_range = c(0.4, 1.4),
  link_width = NULL,
  link_alpha = 0.7,
  show_link_values = FALSE,
  link_value_size = 2,
  link_value_digits = 2,
  circle_radius = 2.8,
  circle_width = 0.4,
  circle_color = "grey65",
  circle_linetype = "dashed",
  outer_ring_size = 0.6,
  outer_ring_color = "grey60",
  outer_ring_alpha = 0.6,
  intra_edge_width = 0.18,
  intra_edge_color = "grey82",
  intra_edge_alpha = 0.35,
  diag_point_size = 2,
  diag_point_fill = "#F781BF",
  diag_point_color = "#C51B7D",
  node_size_range = c(1.1, 3.8),
  hull_alpha = 0.18,
  curvature = 0.14,
  preset = "default",
  scifig = FALSE
)

Arguments

comm_data

Optional numeric matrix or data frame of community abundance data (samples in rows, features in columns). If supplied and links is NULL, empirical linkages are automatically calculated using cli_calc_env_links.

env_data

Numeric matrix, data frame, or named list of 1 to 4 correlation matrices or indicator variables for corner triangular heatmaps. Alias for env_cors.

nodes

Optional data frame of central network nodes.

edges

Optional data frame of central network edges.

env_cors

Alias for env_data.

links

Optional data frame of pre-computed environmental-to-module linkages.

modules

Optional named vector assigning features to module names.

module_labels

Optional character vector or named vector of descriptive module labels.

module_colors

Optional named vector of colors for modules.

corner_palettes

Optional list of 1 to 4 color gradient palettes for the corner heatmaps.

link_colors

Named vector of colors for link directions (default c("Positive" = "#E64B35", "Negative" = "#4DBBD5")).

label_type

Format for heatmap tile values: "auto", "stars", "coef", "coef_stars", or "none".

show_asterisks

Logical. If TRUE, display significance asterisks. Default TRUE.

show_values

Logical. If TRUE, display numeric correlation coefficients. Default FALSE.

value_digits

Integer. Number of decimal places for correlation digits (default 2).

value_size

Numeric. Font size for tile correlation text (default NULL for auto-scaling).

compact

Logical. If TRUE (default), omits leading zero for compact tile text.

show_module_labels

Logical. If TRUE, displays module label badges (default TRUE).

module_label_size

Font size for module label text (default 2.4).

module_label_color

Text color for module labels (default "grey15").

module_label_fill

Background fill color for module labels (default "white").

module_label_bg

Logical. If TRUE, renders bounding badge boxes behind labels (default TRUE).

module_label_alpha

Transparency for module label background (default 1.0).

module_label_pos

Placement strategy for module labels: "radial" (default) or "centroid".

show_module_legend

Logical. If TRUE, shows module color legend (default TRUE).

legend_position

Position of plot legend: "top" (default), "bottom", "right", or "left".

show_domain_labels

Logical. If TRUE, displays corner domain headers (default TRUE).

env_label_size

Font size for environmental variable labels (default 1.95).

env_label_color

Color for environmental variable labels (default "grey20").

env_label_face

Font face for environmental variable labels (default "plain").

link_width_range

Line width range for significance-weighted links (default c(0.4, 1.4)).

link_width

Optional constant line width overriding significance weighting.

link_alpha

Transparency for curved inter-domain links (default 0.70).

show_link_values

Logical. If TRUE, shows correlation coefficients on links (default FALSE).

link_value_size

Font size for link correlation digits (default 2.0).

link_value_digits

Number of decimal places for link correlation digits (default 2).

circle_radius

Radius of central boundary circle (default 2.80).

circle_width

Line width of boundary circle (default 0.4).

circle_color

Color of boundary circle (default "grey65").

circle_linetype

Linetype of boundary circle (default "dashed").

outer_ring_size

Size of dots along outer boundary ring (default 0.6).

outer_ring_color

Color of dots along outer boundary ring (default "grey60").

outer_ring_alpha

Transparency of dots along outer boundary ring (default 0.6).

intra_edge_width

Line width of intra-module edges (default 0.18).

intra_edge_color

Color of intra-module edges (default "grey82").

intra_edge_alpha

Transparency of intra-module edges (default 0.35).

diag_point_size

Size of diagonal indicator connector points (default 2.0).

diag_point_fill

Fill color of diagonal indicator points (default "#F781BF").

diag_point_color

Border color of diagonal indicator points (default "#C51B7D").

node_size_range

Numeric vector of length 2 for node sizes (default c(1.1, 3.8)).

hull_alpha

Shading transparency for module cluster hulls (default 0.18).

curvature

Curvature of inter-domain links (default 0.14).

preset

Publisher style preset: "default", "nature", "clinical", "seasonal", "cell", "dark", "lancet", "minimal", "multi_tissue", "circadian", or "bipolar".

scifig

Logical. If TRUE, enforces AI4SciFig publication gates (default FALSE).

Value

An S3 object of class c("cli_env_network_data", "list") containing layout tables.
